20764.new_name: High-Stretch Chiffon Bodycon Skirt in Two Colors
20764.title_note: small breasted/pure desire/hip wrapped 机翻堆词剥；hip wrapped→Bodycon；High Elasticity 参数回填；双色属实
20764.desc:
Chiffon with real recovery in it is rarer than it should be — the fabric is usually asked to drape, not to cling. This skirt takes the other route: a chiffon weave with high elasticity built in, cut bodycon so it maps the hip instead of floating over it. The result reads as a going-out piece that happens to be sorted with the lingerie.

Because the stretch is doing the fitting, one size covers the whole 40–70 kg band. Black and gray versions split the standard difference — one for statements, one for understatement — and both wash and pack the way simple polyester pieces do: without ceremony. The waistband sits high and flat, the hem finishes mid-thigh, and the whole skirt travels smaller than a sock.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: High-stretch chiffon
  • Style: Bodycon short skirt
  • Colors: Black, gray
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–70 kg (88–154 lbs)

A skirt cut that chiffon is not supposed to survive, and does.
20764.short: Bodycon short skirt in high-stretch chiffon, black or gray, one size covering 40–70 kg with the stretch doing the fitting.
20764.tkd_title: High-Stretch Chiffon Bodycon Skirt in Two Colors | RoseToys
20764.tkd_desc: High-stretch chiffon bodycon skirt in black or gray, one size for 40-70 kg. Club-ready cut with a flat high waist, at RoseToys.

20765.new_name: High-Waist Split Mini Nightdress in Three Colors
20765.title_note: suspender 吊带误译纠正→high-waist mini 语境；nightclub style 参数入正文；三色上标题
20765.desc:
A high waist does most of its work before anything else about a dress is noticed: it reorganizes the proportions of the torso, lengthens the leg line, and gives a short skirt a reason to be short. This nightdress is built around exactly that move — a raised waistband, a mini hem, and a split at the leg that keeps the whole thing in motion.

The fabric is chiffon, light enough that the high waist does not read as structure but as line. Nightclub styling is the intended register, and the three colors track that: black and red play it straight, pink plays it a half-tone lighter. The split sits at the side of the leg rather than the front, which keeps the reveal for moments of movement instead of handing it over standing still.

Fast facts:

  • Fabric: Chiffon
  • Style: High-waist mini nightdress
  • Key detail: Leg split
  • Colors: Black, pink, red
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

One proportion change, and the whole dress follows.
20765.short: High-waist chiffon mini nightdress with a leg split, in black, pink or red, one size for 40–60 kg, nightclub styling.
20765.tkd_title: High-Waist Split Mini Nightdress in Three Colors | RoseToys
20765.tkd_desc: High-waist chiffon mini nightdress with a side leg split, in black, pink or red. One size for the 40-60 kg band. At RoseToys.

20769.title_note: hollow open cut 直译→Cut-Out；sexy perspective→Sheer；单色黑
20769.desc:
Cut-outs are a way of directing attention: each one is a decision about where the eye rests, and a jumpsuit covered in them makes a lot of decisions at once. This piece spreads its cut-outs across a sheer black body, so the overall effect is less a pattern of holes than a continuous negotiation between fabric and skin.

The base is a polyester knit with enough stretch to hold the cut edges flat — raw-edged openings that gape are the failure mode of this style, and the fabric is what prevents it. One size covers the standard band, with the stretch absorbing the rest. The neckline runs high and plain, a deliberate counterweight: with this much skin in play elsewhere, the top of the piece stays out of the conversation. Pull it on and the map of cut-outs settles where the pattern intended.

The rundown:

  • Fabric: Sheer stretch polyester
  • Style: One-piece jumpsuit
  • Key detail: All-over cut-outs
  • Color: Black
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

Black sheer, strategically incomplete.
20769.short: One-piece black jumpsuit in sheer stretch polyester with all-over cut-outs and a high plain neckline, one size for 40–60 kg.
20769.tkd_title: Cut-Out Sheer Jumpsuit in Black | RoseToys
20769.tkd_desc: Cut-out sheer jumpsuit in black stretch polyester with all-over cut-outs and a plain neckline. One size, 40-60 kg, at RoseToys.

20776.title_note: no-off（免脱）剥；butterfly lace+two-piece 参数回填；⚠️原 desc 含 'little one' 儿童化表述必清除（本次重写即清除）
20776.desc:
Butterfly lace is a pattern with a longer history than most of the drawer it ends up in, and it survives because the motif does quiet work: it gives sheer fabric a focal point and a repeatable rhythm. This two-piece set uses it across a halter-neck nightdress, so the butterflies carry the design and the halter carries the structure.

As a set it is straightforward — the nightdress, and a second piece that completes the pairing, both in chiffon-light lace that breathes. The halter neck leaves the shoulders and back bare, which is where the pattern does its best showing. Black and white versions run the usual two directions: graphic and bridal-adjacent. Both take a cold wash and a hanger, and both come out of the drawer looking the way they went in, which is more than most lace can say.

What the set includes:

  • Fabric: Chiffon lace with butterfly motif
  • Style: Two-piece halter nightdress set
  • Colors: Black, white
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–79 kg (88–174 lbs)

An old pattern, cut for the way it is worn now.
20776.short: Two-piece halter nightdress set in butterfly lace, black or white, one wide size for 40–79 kg, chiffon-light, breathable and cold-wash.
20776.tkd_title: Butterfly Lace Halter Nightdress Set | RoseToys
20776.tkd_desc: Butterfly lace halter nightdress set, two pieces in black or white, one wide size for 40-79 kg. Halter cut at RoseToys.

20782.new_name: Chiffon Slip Nightdress and Robe Loungewear Set
20782.title_note: suspender 吊带误译纠正→slip；dressing gown+bathrobe→robe 收敛；三码属实
20782.desc:
A nightdress sold with its own robe is a complete answer: the pair covers both the wearing and the not-quite-wearing, which is most of the evening. This set pairs a thin chiffon slip with a matching robe, cut from the same fabric so the two layers read as one design rather than a nightdress plus an afterthought.

The slip is the base layer — thin, straight, unstructured — and the robe does the styling: worn open it adds movement, belted it adds shape, and hung on the door it does what robes do for a living. Three graded sizes rather than one stretch compromise, because chiffon does not forgive a bad band. The robe runs to mid-calf on most wearers, long enough to be a robe and short enough not to swallow the slip underneath it.

The breakdown:

  • Fabric: Chiffon
  • Pieces: Slip nightdress and matching robe
  • Colors: As pictured
  • Sizes: M (40–50 kg / 88–110 lbs), L (50–60 kg / 110–132 lbs), XL (60–70 kg / 132–154 lbs)

Two layers, one coordinated exit.
20782.short: Chiffon slip nightdress with a matching robe, two coordinated pieces in three sizes from M to XL for 40–70 kg.
20782.tkd_title: Chiffon Slip Nightdress and Robe Loungewear Set | RoseToys
20782.tkd_desc: Chiffon slip nightdress with a matching mid-calf robe, a two-piece set in sizes M to XL for 40-70 kg. Direct from RoseToys.

20786.title_note: velvet 与参数 chiffon 冲突→材质不上标题；passionate and sexy 堆词剥；vintage+Chinese 属实
20786.desc:
The vintage route in cheongsam lingerie means restraint in the cut and confidence in the fabric: nothing stretched, nothing exposed by accident, the silhouette doing what it has done for a century. This nightdress takes that route — mandarin collar, diagonal front, a fitted line through the waist, and a skirt that stops where tradition stops.

As sleepwear it is comfortable in the old-fashioned way: light fabric, no hardware, and a cut that stays put through the night rather than riding up. The styling tips it toward lingerie, but the bones of the piece are genuinely vintage. The side closure sits flat under the diagonal line, and nothing on the dress asks to be adjusted once it is on. As a gift it reads thoughtful; as a purchase it reads self-aware.

Quick specs:

  • Fabric: Chiffon
  • Style: Cheongsam nightdress with mandarin collar
  • Colors: As pictured
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

A hundred years of silhouette, one night at a time.
20786.short: Vintage-cut cheongsam nightdress in chiffon with mandarin collar, diagonal front and flat side closure, one size for 40–60 kg, no hardware.
20786.tkd_desc: Vintage Chinese-style cheongsam nightdress in chiffon, with mandarin collar and flat side closure, one size, 40-60 kg, at RoseToys.

20795.title_note: pure lust（纯欲）slipsuit 生造词→slip nightdress 规范；宽容量 40-70kg 进正文
20795.desc:
A slip that doubles as a nightdress has to survive both readings: sexy enough to justify the lace, plain enough to actually sleep in. This one manages the double by keeping the construction simple — a straight lace body, thin straps, a hem that lands where slips land — and letting the fabric carry the register on its own.

The fit is genuinely generous: a 70–120 cm bust range and 60–90 cm waist range under a single size, with the lace absorbing the difference. That width is a feature rather than a compromise; the drape of a slip depends on the fabric having room to fall. The straps are the only adjustable element, and they adjust by slider rather than by knot, which keeps the line of the shoulder clean. Everything else on the dress is a fixed decision, made well.

The specifics:

  • Fabric: Lace
  • Style: Slip nightdress
  • Colors: As pictured
  • Fit: One size (bust 70–120 cm, waist 60–90 cm), recommended 40–70 kg (88–154 lbs)

One piece, two jobs, no conflict between them.
20795.short: Simple lace slip nightdress with thin straps and a generous cut, bust range 70–120 cm, one size for 40–70 kg.
20795.tkd_desc: Lace slip nightdress in one generous size for 40-70 kg, with a 70-120 cm bust range and slider straps. Simple slip at RoseToys.

20801.new_name: Chiffon Slip Nightdress in Two Colors
20801.title_note: satin 与参数 chiffon 冲突→satin 剥；loungewear pajamas 堆词收敛；双色属实
20801.desc:
Two colors of the same chiffon slip make the choice simple before the evening starts: black for intention, white for the absence of it. The dress underneath the choice is identical — a straight slip in light chiffon, cut as a nightdress, with nothing on it that needs deciding twice.

Chiffon is the reason this style works as sleepwear. It weighs next to nothing, it falls straight off the shoulder line, and it holds enough shape at the bust to keep the slip reading as a garment rather than a sheet with straps. One size covers the standard weight band, and the single seam at the bust does quietly important work: it gives the slip a front and a back, which is the difference between a garment and a tube of fabric. The hem finishes at mid-thigh, the straps sit thin at the shoulder, and the rest is air.

Fast facts:

  • Fabric: Chiffon
  • Style: Slip nightdress
  • Colors: Black, white
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

The plainest possible version of the idea, in both registers.
20801.short: Straight chiffon slip nightdress in black or white, one size for 40–60 kg, cut plain with nothing to decide twice.
20801.tkd_title: Chiffon Slip Nightdress in Two Colors | RoseToys
20801.tkd_desc: Chiffon slip nightdress in black or white, one size for 40-60 kg, mid-thigh hem with a thin strap. Plain slip at RoseToys.

20803.title_note: feminine/one-piece pajamas 弱词剥；jumpsuit 参数→teddy 品类词；宽容量 40-70kg 进正文
20803.desc:
One piece of lace from shoulder to hem is the entire architecture of this nightdress: no separates to coordinate, no straps to re-tie, no second piece waiting on a chair. The teddy cut keeps it as a single continuous garment, which is precisely the appeal — one motion on, one silhouette, done.

The lace body is sheer with a repeating openwork pattern, and the fit runs wide by design: a 70–120 cm bust range and 60–90 cm waist range under the single size, so the pattern stretches to the wearer rather than the wearer negotiating with the pattern. As a nightdress it sleeps cooler than a slip of the same coverage, because openwork lace moves air the way solid weave cannot.

What you are getting:

  • Fabric: Sheer lace
  • Style: One-piece teddy nightdress
  • Colors: As pictured
  • Fit: One size (bust 70–120 cm, waist 60–90 cm), recommended 40–70 kg (88–154 lbs)

One garment, one motion, no committee.
20803.short: One-piece lace teddy nightdress, sheer openwork with a generous one-size fit for 40–70 kg and a 70—120 cm bust range.
20803.tkd_desc: One-piece lace teddy nightdress, sheer openwork in one generous stretch size for 40-70 kg. Single-garment slip at RoseToys.

20815.title_note: 剥货号「T- 2423」（空格变体）；Sensible（乱译）剥；五件组成（bracelet+neck ring+T-pants+chain+jumpsuit）入正文
20815.desc:
Five-piece sets succeed when every component clearly belongs to the same design, and chains are the easiest way to make that argument: one visual idea, repeated across everything. Here patent leather carries the base — a jumpsuit and T-back panty in matching gloss — while the chain runs through the rest: at the neck, at the wrist, and across the set as connective hardware.

Worn together, the five pieces read as a single engineered look rather than a costume kit; worn in part, the jumpsuit still stands alone with the chains doing their work at the collarbone and wrist. That modularity is the practical case for buying the whole set at once rather than assembling it a piece at a time, and the gloss finish matches across all five components because they left the same design process.

The full listing includes:

  • Fabric: Patent leather with metal chain
  • Pieces: Jumpsuit, T-back panty, chain, neck ring, bracelet
  • Colors: As pictured
  • Fit: One size, recommended 40–60 kg (88–132 lbs)

One material, one hardware, five pieces that agree with each other.
20815.short: Five-piece patent leather set with chains: jumpsuit, T-back panty, neck ring, bracelet and chain, one wide size for 40–60 kg.
20815.tkd_title: Chain Patent Leather Lingerie Set | RoseToys
20815.tkd_desc: Five-piece chain patent leather set: jumpsuit, T-back panty, neck ring and bracelet, one size for 40-60 kg. At RoseToys.
